attributes.board_name: Oklahoma State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision

rules.accepted_credit_types: All Category I CME hours sponsored or approved by the state and national associations
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from reporting CME until one year after licensure.
rules.audit_note: Yearly random or for-cause audit; 30 days to submit proof. Missing the Dec 31 deadline means 40 Category I hours are required.

topics.who: All PAs: at least 1 hour of Category I CME on substance abuse each calendar year

rules.notes: CME is counted per calendar year (preceding year). Licenses are renewed annually on a date set by the Board.
